description: Additive one-page definition: one view:app instance on an explicitly named page. Does not replace pages.json, QuickLaunch or existing pages.

DraftListId.description: Caller-secured server draft list GUID; blank disabled.

DraftPolicyJson.description: IServerDraftPolicy JSON: qualified, qualificationReceiptRef, retentionPolicyRef, accessPolicyRef, retentionDays, qualifiedUntil. Blank disabled; commissioning is external.

CoreBindingJson.description: CORE v0.2.0 binding JSON: contractVersion, requestListId, resultListId, tenantLabel, qualified, qualificationReceiptRef, testRecord. Blank disabled.

MarketingBindingJson.description: Marketing binding JSON: enabled, siteUrl, requestListId, resultListId, qualificationReceiptRef. Blank disabled.

OrganizationName.description: Organization name written on the instance.

GovernanceReference.description: Policy reference; blank keeps default wording and is reported AWAITING.

ReviewSystemName.description: Review-system name; blank keeps default wording.

DraftServiceUrl.description: Idea-draft flow URL; blank keeps plain summaries.

LeadersGroup.description: Site group for the leader role; blank leaves the role unbound.

OperatorsGroup.description: Site group for the operator role; blank leaves the role unbound.

DesignAuthorityGroup.description: Site group for design authority; blank leaves the role unbound.

MarketingParticipantsGroup.description: Site group for the bounded Marketing participant role; blank leaves it unbound.

MarketingReviewersGroup.description: Site group for Marketing reviewers; blank leaves it unbound. Not an approval identity.

SupportUrl.description: Support route; blank leaves the in-app footer unbound.

Palette.description: Palette overrides as key=#hex pairs; blank keeps shipped colours.

PageFile.description: Site Pages file to place the instance on, for example Front-Door.aspx.
